warmups: One excluded case8 solve for each BPR model, initial seed 2040.
intervention: Only the second models.txt line (BPR Poisson engine); no tuning, training or new model selection.
comparison: New Full models versus historical protocol-matched P0 raw, matched by case and initial FRW seed; not contemporaneous or common-path pairing.
standard_deviation: Sample SD (ddof=1) across three model-specific 10-case macro means; includes residual FRW evaluation noise.

release_scope: Capacitance records and CPU reaggregation. Additional seed2039/2053 model files and original solver logs are not bundled; the default inference runner remains seed2029.
